description: Unit test class 'SendFeatureMessageTest' for testing the 'SendFeatureMessage' class related to messaging commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It verifies instantiation, equality, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling for message creation with specific features.
